name: Find 87
summary: A fast-paced homebrew puzzle game where players are presented with grids filled with numbers and must quickly spot and select the hidden number 87 before the timer expires. The game challenges visual perception and speed across three distinct modes: a 99-level Easy Mode where surrounding numbers match the current stage, a 10-level Hard Mode featuring randomized non-repeating numbers from 1 to 99, and an N x N Mode where the grid size expands with each stage from 1x1 up to 10x10. Making an incorrect selection penalizes the player by deducting time from the clock.
